item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 13:00
Institution: Univ. VERONA, Verona
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-03 Psicologia sociale, del lavoro e delle organizzazioni

The research programme investigates the role of digital technologies and artificial intelligence in promoting occupational well-being and preventing psychosocial risks. Particular attention will be devoted to the development and evaluation of innovative assessment approaches, including digital measures and vocal biomarkers, and to the study of human–technology interaction in work settings. The research will examine acceptance, trust, usability, and the psychological and organisational effects of intelligent systems, integrating qualitative and quantitative methods, longitudinal designs, and advanced data analysis.
